description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Double bed in the left zone against the upper wall; a sofa in the lower-left area facing into the room; dining table with four chairs centred near the entry. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners unclear if facing the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed visible from front door, visible from kitchen. Fully open plan — cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area directly. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. One bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet). Single bathroom — all household members share one shower, sequential morning routine. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (single open studio, no separate bedrooms); roommates needing privacy (open-plan sleeping area visible from entry and kitchen); remote workers needing a dedicated office (no desk or enclosed work space).
